title: Viva Glint: customise the Teams survey notifications
summary: The roadmap description, existing Viva Glint controls and licensing statements are supported. The page incorrectly makes a Teams app setup policy a prerequisite for delivery, although Microsoft documents individual installation and a different installation route for organisations using app-centric management. The governance checklist also names controls missing from the table.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Teams delivery depends on installing Viva Glint through a Teams app setup policy.
claims.quote: If your organization uses app centric management functionality, then use Manage apps page to install agents and apps for users. Otherwise, continue to preinstall agents and apps using setup policies.
claims.fix: Replace the mandatory setup-policy wording with 'The Viva Glint app must be installed for recipients. For central installation, organisations using app-centric management use Manage apps; other organisations can use Teams app setup policies.' Apply that qualification to the installation checklist and Governance controls prose. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/teams-app-setup-policies. Do not describe a setup policy as a delivery prerequisite: https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/glint/setup/glint-teams also documents individual installation.

claims.claim: The organisation-level setting is in Viva Glint at Configuration > Service Configuration > General Settings > Communications > Microsoft Teams.
claims.quote:
Select the Configuration symbol and in the Service Configuration section, choose General Settings.
In the Communications section, switch the Microsoft Teams toggle to Yes.

claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Microsoft Teams notifications General Settings Communications API Microsoft Graph PowerShell configuration. Opened learn.microsoft.com/viva/glint/setup/glint-teams; searched General Settings excerpts. No setting operation was returned.

claims.claim: The survey-program channel setting is in Viva Glint at Configuration > Surveys > Survey Programs > survey > Communications > Channels > Microsoft Teams.
claims.quote:
Select the Configuration symbol and in the Surveys section choose Survey Programs.
Select a survey and go to the Communications section.
In the Channels section, switch the Microsoft Teams toggle to On.
